scope: Genuine hidden terrain repair only. Final background incorporation is clipped to the full approved actor alpha; approved F must remain decoded-RGBA identical.

guild.description: A small real horizontal pale stone ledge at the base of the library terrace wall, beneath the future hanging own stone pillar; the ledge is at native y177 and merges with the mossy rock side without any building.

harmony.description: A tiny flat pale stone landing for the future pavilion left post at native445,158, replacing only the upper-right corner of the stairs; the public descending steps remain west of the landing.

inn.description: A short flat pale stone side-porch foundation landing at native608,339; the downward public stair remains on the LEFT/west side and terminates naturally against this horizontal bed rather than continuing underneath the future inn wall.
